newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar gently firmer but trade muted.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar gently firmer but trade muted.

text.p: White sugar futures were reluctant to stray too far from morning trading levels on Friday afternoon as a lacklustre performance in New York failed to inspire fresh sentiment.
Traders said London was unlikely to show much inclination to move while the New York stalemate between fund buyers against trade and producer sellers continued.
"They (funds) piled in and it's banging its head again," said one trader, referring to both the raws and whites markets.
"The funds will only ever buy strength, they will never buy setbacks so while the market's coming down you won't see them," he said.
London's benchmark October contract held steady in a tight range of $1.90 an accounted for just over half the relatively light volume of 1,539 lots.
At 1550 GMT the spot position stood 60 cents higher at $328.50 while December was up 70 cents at $323.50. Other traded positions also gained ground but movements were tight across the board.
The Paris market was also firmer with October dominating turnover, up $1.60 at $328.60. December was up $1.10 at $322.60 and Matif volume totalled 646 lots.
